reui._comment: ReUI's own live registry server. Declared here so installing this plugin DELIVERS it — a server configured by hand on one machine reaches nobody who installs the marketplace. Unauthenticated until the user runs /mcp, selects reui and chooses Authenticate: a browser sign-in they complete themselves, so no credential is ever held in this repo, in a plugin, or by an agent. Until then it reports 'Needs authentication' and the local registry-source server above still answers for Aceternity, shadcn and Magic UI. Headless environments use a personal token via an Authorization header instead — that is the user's to add locally, never committed here.
